🚀 We're Hiring: Senior Manager – Corporate Sales | Global Insurance Broking Firm
 
📍 Gurgaon | Noida | Kolkata | Chennai | Hyderabad | Bengaluru
 
Do you love the thrill of the hunt? Are you the person who turns a cold intro into a closed deal — and a closed deal into a long-term relationship?
 
We're a global, employee-owned insurance broking powerhouse — 55+ countries, 150+ risk solutions, one entrepreneurial culture. And we're looking for a Corporate Sales leader in India who can drive that same energy into new markets.
 
🎯 What you'll own: • Build and scale high-value corporate client relationships 
• Spot the white space in the market — and go get it
• Own a strong, sustainable sales pipeline end to end
• Partner closely with insurers, TPAs, and internal teams
• Represent the firm at the table with corporates, MNCs, and industry leaders
 
✅ What you bring:
• 10–18 years of direct corporate sales experience in insurance broking
 • A hunter's instinct and a networker's charm
 • Sharp market mapping and strategic thinking
 • A university degree (insurance qualification is a plus)
 
If you're driven by targets, energized by relationships, and ready to build something big with a global brand that still moves like a startup — let's talk.
 
📩 Apply now to maria@prosapiens.in or Whatsapp profile to maria@prosapiens.in.

#Hiring #InsuranceBroking #CorporateSales #SalesJobs #InsuranceCareers #Gurgaon #Noida #Kolkata #Chennai #Hyderabad #Bengaluru
comment: Corporate sales success in insurance broking often depends not just on acquiring accounts, but on understanding risk priorities and building advisory trust beyond pricing conversations.
